text:
Maya R: morning team! excited to be here. small snag: Okta shows me as active but when I try to enroll a passkey I get 'Enrollment failed: unauthorized'. Also the 1Password invite says 'this invite is no longer valid'. who should I loop in?

Oliver (IT): welcome Maya :wave: Ping People Ops for 1Password resend. For the Okta passkey error, can you tell me the browser and OS?

Maya R: macOS Monterey, Safari 15.1. I tried Chrome too, same result. 1Password invite was sent to maya.r@redwood.dev.

Priya (People Ops): hi Maya  sorry about the expired invite, we had a scheduled batch yesterday. I'll revoke the old and send a new 1Password seat to maya.r@redwood.dev right away.

IT Support Bot: Ticket #INC-2122 created: "New hire Maya - Okta passkey unauthorized + 1Password expired invite". Assigned to Oliver (IT).

Oliver (IT): thanks Priya. Maya, that Okta message usually means device trust hasn't completed or there's an alias mismatch. Can you confirm if you have any other corporate alias (e.g., m.r@redwood.dev)? Also try an incognito/private window and attempt enrollment again.

Maya R: no other alias that I know of. tried private window and still fails. No phone push showed up either.

Sam K: adding a note: if the original invite used a different alias the Drive/repo shares can be created to that alias and cause permission confusion later. Good to straighten that now.

Oliver (IT): I'm going to check the directory. If there's an alias we can consolidate; I'll also force an Okta device-trust reset and push a new enrollment packet. Priya, did the 1Password resend go out?

Priya (People Ops): sent new invite to maya.r@redwood.dev — let me know if it lands in Spam/Promotions.

Maya R: got the 1Password invite! set up and enabled MFA. thanks Priya.

Oliver (IT): I pushed the device-trust reset. Try enrolling the passkey now and accept any mobile prompts. If still failing, I'll escalate to oncall.

Maya R: enrolling now... success! device trust shows active and I can sign in. everything looks good. Thanks everyone :grin:

Sam K: welcome aboard Maya. For repos DM me or Marc and we'll add you to the appropriate teams.

Maya R: will do, appreciate the quick help :)
